---
title: "Participation & Surface Loss"
sidebar: simulation
---

Calculate where a selected mode stores energy, then apply explicitly chosen
material and interface loss assumptions. Use an LC/EPR tutorial rather than
treating an unloaded frequency calculation as a participation result.

## Model and prerequisites

Preserve conductor and junction/load definitions, stack, exterior, and the
requested surfaces or volumes. MA, MS, and SA identify different interfaces;
their thickness, permittivity, loss tangent, and field side are selected model inputs.

Use the selected tutorial's Palace or AEDT environment and saved-field settings.
Read [Materials & Interfaces](../../start/materials.qmd) before choosing a preset.

## Read participation and loss

Read each contribution with its energy denominator, selected mode and pass,
interface/field-side identity, and saved-field inputs. Keep signed junction
contributions identifiable. Participation, assumption-based loss, native Q,
and measured lifetime are different quantities.

For geometric correction, inspect the selected original-parent bands, sampled
region, retained region, and returned Q2D factor together. The tutorial's
straight-edge approximation does not establish corner equivalence.

Use [SimplePad HFSS routes](eigenmode.qmd#simplepad-hfss-handoff-sequence) to choose the separated Prepare Handoff → Run prepared package path or the single-notebook Run Directly path. Both can continue to the shared [Analyze notebook](../../notebooks/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/aedt_hfss_eigenmode_analyze.ipynb) · <a href="../../notebooks/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/aedt_hfss_eigenmode_analyze.ipynb" data-noresolveinput download>IPYNB</a> · <a href="../../notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/aedt_hfss_eigenmode_analyze.qmd" data-noresolveinput download>QMD</a>.

Analyze keeps two optional operations separate: saved-field evaluation uses an
AEDT license but does not solve, while detached loss reanalysis reads saved
data offline. Choose either only when that additional analysis is needed.
